bibdata.title: Requirements for resource management in cloud-aware telecommunication management systems
Requirements for resource management in cloud-aware telecommunication management systems
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T M.3372 introduces a functional framework and functional requirements for resource management in cloud-aware telecommunication management systems. It provides the composition of the functional framework and the functions of each component in the framework. In this Recommendation, the general background and status of cloud computing management are also analysed. The benefit of introducing a functional framework and functional requirements for resource management in cloud-aware telecommunication management systems is also explained.
